wikipedia.title: Beaver Lake (Arkansas)
wikipedia.extract: Beaver Lake is a man-made reservoir in the Ozark Mountains of Northwest Arkansas formed by a dam across the White River. Beaver Lake has some 487 miles (784 km) of shoreline with towering limestone bluffs, natural caves, a variety of trees and flowering shrubs, making it a popular tourist destination.  Beaver Lake is named after the town of Beaver near one of the original proposed dam sites who incidentally got its name from 1850s settlor Wilson Ashbury Beaver.
